description: Order-call arguments (uid TEST123) to the endpoint and the exact request body (see jdata_encoding.json), or {"error": "RequestValidationError", "fields": [...]} when client-side validation rejects the arguments before anything is sent; fields lists the wire keys of the field-level errors, sorted (empty when only a cross-field rule failed, such as MTF on MCX). input.call is place_order (PlaceOrder; wire key order uid, actid, exch, tsym, qty, prc, trgprc, dscqty, prd, trantype, prctyp, ret, amo, remarks, ordersource, blprc, bpprc, trailprc, mkt_protection, algo_id; amo is always sent as Yes or No), modify_order (ModifyOrder; no amo; ret only when a validity is given; algo_id last, as on PlaceOrder; algo_id must be a non-blank string when given), cancel_order (CancelOrder: uid, norenordno), exit_order (ExitSNOOrder: uid, norenordno, prd H or B), order_margin (GetOrderMargin, a read), place_gtt (PlaceGTTOrder; wire key order uid, actid, exch, tsym, ai_t, d, validity, remarks, trantype, prctyp, prd, ret, qty, prc, trgprc, dscqty; alert_type -> ai_t, trigger_value -> d, alert_validity -> validity (DAY or GTT, default GTT), validity -> ret (default DAY), tag -> remarks (required, non-blank); exchanges NSE, NFO, BSE, BFO, MCX and products CNC, NRML, CO only; quantity in the exchange's trade units, a whole multiple of the lot size, on MCX too; no ordersource, no algo_id), modify_gtt (ModifyGTTOrder: the same keys with al_id third; validity and alert_validity have no defaults on modify_gtt, so every modify_gtt case gives both and both are always sent) or cancel_gtt (CancelGTTOrder: uid, al_id); GTT case names start with gtt_. place_gtt and modify_gtt refuse the OCO alert types LMT_BOS_O and LMT_SOB_O (fields ['ai_t']: an OCO is placed and changed only with place_oco and modify_oco, see oco_requests.json). Absent optional keys are omitted; a MARKET / SL-M order without a price is sent with prc "0".
